issues.description: Function name mismatch for the one-round MSD simulation entry point: the problem statement and the solution expect a function named simulate_msd_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float) but the template defines simulate_one_round(n_shots: int, p: float). Additionally, the template's plot_msd implementation (calls in the template code) already calls simulate_msd_one_round, creating an inconsistent situation where the template defines a differently named function than callers and the specification expect. This inconsistency will cause NameError/undefined-function failures for students running or testing the repository and will confuse which symbol they must implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the template's simulate_one_round(...) function to simulate_msd_one_round(...) (updating its signature line 121 in template msd.py), and ensure any internal callers (e.g., plot_msd in template msd.py at lines ~155-156) refer to the same name. Alternatively, change the problem statement and solution to use simulate_one_round everywhere, but keeping simulate_msd_one_round is preferable to match the specification. Update tests or callers if necessary.
